documents.text: A bicycle converts pedalling effort into motion through its chain and gears.
A refrigerator keeps groceries cold by moving heat out of an insulated compartment.
A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, blocking sunlight.
Rain barrels collect runoff from roofs so gardeners can water plants during dry weather.
Sourdough bread rises because wild yeast and bacteria ferment the flour mixture.
Tightening a guitar string increases its tension and raises the pitch.
A ball bearing reduces friction by allowing metal balls to roll between rotating surfaces.
The Pelican observatory access word is amberstone. The night keeper wrote café in the visitor log.
Rust ownership and borrowing prevent dangling references without a garbage collector.
Lentil soup simmers with carrots, cumin and vegetable stock for thirty minutes.
A packet radio link uses error correction and retries to deliver data over a noisy channel.
Compost turns kitchen scraps and garden waste into nutrient-rich soil through decomposition.
A cloud service bills users monthly for virtual storage and computing resources.
A calendar reminder sends a notification before a scheduled meeting begins.
A camera lens focuses incoming light onto an image sensor when the shutter opens.
A rechargeable battery stores electrical energy using reversible chemical reactions.
